name: Tamyam creme Chocolat wafters
ingredients_raw: WAFER: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), CORN STARCH, SOYA FLOUR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), EMULSIFIER (INS 322), LEAVENING AGENT [INS 450 (I) AND INS 500 (II)], SALT. CREAM: SUGAR, EDIBLE HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FAT (PALM, SESAME & COCONUT), GLUCOSE POWDER, DEXTROSE, COCOA SOLIDS (2%), MALTODEXTRIN, MILK SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER (INS 322), SALT. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (INS 150D) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CHOCOLATE)
